observations: Photo 0 shows a black PS4 Slim console lying flat with two black DualShock 4 controllers crossed on top.
A power cable, a usb/controller cable, and what looks like an HDMI cable are coiled beside the console.
No power-on screen, no serial number plate, no box, and no game discs or digital library screen are visible.
Console body shows the slim, single-tone matte finish typical of PS4 Slim design; no visible scratches or damage in this image, but resolution is low.

claims.evidence: No close-up of casing, no UK plug/power brick markings, no grading report visible in photo 0.
Photo 0 clearly shows two DualShock 4 controllers on top of the console.
No screen, menu, or storage/library screenshot shown; cannot confirm any games are installed or licensed to an account.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (overheating, disc drive failure, HDMI port issues).
risks.proof: A video of the console powering on to the PS4 home screen, including disc eject if applicable.

risks.risk: Claimed games may be pirated, from a jailbroken system, or not tied to a legitimate account, adding no resale value.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the PS4 library/settings showing purchased titles under an account, and firmware version shown in Settings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as base console only, no added value for games

risks.risk: Controllers could have battery degradation, stick drift, or connectivity faults.
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connecting wirelessly and a quick analog stick movement test on screen.

risks.risk: Storage capacity and HDD health unknown (could be swapped for smaller/failing drive).
risks.proof: Screenshot of Settings > Storage showing capacity and used space.
risks.if_unproven: priced at base/lowest common capacity assumption

risks.risk: 'UK used / Grade A' cosmetic claim unverified; hidden cracks, yellowing, or sticker residue not visible at this resolution.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photos of all sides, vents, and ports in good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as average/ungraded used condition, not Grade A

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on to the home screen, showing system menu and settings.
Screenshot of Settings > System > System Information (firmware version) and Storage (capacity/used space).
Screenshot of the game library showing the 10 titles and FC26 listed under an account.
Close-up photos of the console body (top, vents, ports) and both controllers from multiple angles.
Video of both controllers connecting and analog sticks being tested.
response.reason: The console and two controllers are clearly identifiable as a PS4 Slim set, but no functional proof (power-on, game library, controller test) is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly non-working unit with unconfirmed game content.
